items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: And his son, the one that's playing now, used to walk between us and hold both of us's horn under one arm.

ctx.x: One more question about the, did you ever play any parades very much in New Orleans?
Played the most, the first parades that I made in New Orleans was from, what's the younger player's name? It's a bit of a thing, you can't think of nobody.
Well, Freddie Keppert or? No. Manuel Perrinas? Henry Allen. Oh, Henry Allen.
